spans.text: America : being the latest, and most accurate description of the New World : containing the original of the inhabitants, and the remarkable voyages thither : the conquest of the vast empires of Mexico and Peru, and other large provinces and territories, with the several European plantations in those parts : also their cities, fortresses, towns, temples, mountains, and rivers : their habits, customs, manners, and religions : their plants, beasts, birds, and serpents : with an appendix containing, besides several other considerable additions, a brief survey of what hath been discover'd of the unknown south-land and the Arctick region identifier: America00Ogil creator: Ogilby, John, 1600-1676, Montanus, Arnoldus, 1625?-1683 date: 1671-01-01T00:00:00Z license: unknown mediatype: texts
